title: Node analysis work bound
statement: Let $n,k$, and $b$ be natural numbers, and let $P$ be a set of coordinates among the $n$ coordinates. The node analysis work bound for $P$ at parameter $k$, with failure parameter equal to the per-call failure obtained from the dyadic failure parameter with $b$ bits, is at most the node analysis linear coefficient at $k$ times $(n+1)^{\lfloor 3k/4\rfloor+3}(b+1)$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite set $P$ of coordinates among the $n$ coordinates
